featured_reviews.name: K. “ContentName” F.
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited this newly opened juice center right at the busy Vakola intersection. Surprised to learn  they're open till 1am, which draws in plenty of late-night customers from the area.

It's a small place with no seating inside, so parcel is the way to go (they offer home delivery too, though I didn't spot a contact number displayed). Been open just about 2 months, serving great fresh juices and  milkshakes.

No flies were spotted so it's a good sign. Cleaner than the others. They served juices in some fancy glasses too (The first I've seen outside a restaurant). It the small things that make a difference.

Quality seems promising so far. Let's see how they hold up in this competitive spot, but early signs are good. I've certainly planned a visit over the weekend...after dinner.

Poor quality - You spend 1800-2400/kg on dry fruits and obviously good quality is expected, but last few occasions the nuts are of poor quality even the makhana's.

For example, when I asked why the amount of the person ahead of me was added to my bill, the staff said it was due to machine error, but I doubt that when it happens repeatedly.
We all believe in you and your products, so please raise your standards and rethink your staff and service.

featured_reviews.name: Akshay Kunkolienkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
**Very disappointing experience at Squeez Juice Bars, Mumbai International Airport.**

I ordered a cold coffee and specifically requested that no ice be added. However, the coffee tasted strange and felt as if it contained crushed ice. When I asked the staff about it, I was told that they do not use fresh milk for preparing cold coffee and other milk-based beverages. Instead, they freeze the milk and use the frozen milk while preparing drinks.

This is extremely disappointing for a shop operating inside an international airport. Customers pay premium prices expecting quality, hygiene, and proper food standards. The cold coffee cost ₹300, yet the quality was far below expectations.

The taste was so unpleasant that I could not finish the drink and ended up throwing it away. After a few sips, I developed a sore throat, making the experience even worse.

Using frozen milk instead of fresh milk for milk-based drinks is not what customers expect when ordering a premium beverage. I would strongly advise others to be cautious when ordering milk-based items here.

Overall, a very poor experience, poor value for money, and not the quality one would expect at an international airport. I would not recommend this shop.

featured_reviews.name: Bell Saffron
featured_reviews.review_text:
A very compact restaurant
Feedback:

The first-floor AC section at Hotel Amar Fast Food is a well-planned, Mumbaiya-style space with seating for 42+. While the layout is efficient, the indoor air quality was let down by a stale smell right at entry.

We ordered Pav Bhaji with a custom request for crisp, _kadak_ pav. The pav delivered and scored a solid 9/10, but the bhaji was 7/10 — typical street-style with a more fluid consistency and average taste. It came with lemon and masala onions, though the onions were a bit salty. Overall, the palate experience felt like classic Bombaiya street food.

The water jug had a fresh cluster of green pudina, but we were hesitant to touch it due to hygiene concerns.
The staffs are very courteous, and Swift to suggest, with a service that is comparable to Good standards, All in all, it’s a place you can visit once. There’s scope for improvement in hygiene and cleanliness. Good Luck.

featured_reviews.name: Rahul Yadav
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Amar Juice Centre, a place I’d heard quite a bit about—especially for its pav bhaji.

I tried the butter pav bhaji and a mango shake. To be honest, the pav bhaji didn’t quite live up to the hype for me. It was decent, but nothing particularly memorable, and it didn’t really satisfy that nostalgic craving for authentic Mumbai-style pav bhaji that I was hoping for.

The mango shake, however, was the standout. It was fresh, flavorful, and easily the highlight of the visit.

The setup is pretty straightforward—located right on the main road, with a stand-and-eat format. You can also enjoy your food in your parked car, which is quite convenient. The staff was courteous, and the service was impressively quick, which adds to the overall ease of the experience.

Overall, Amar Juice Centre is worth a stop for its juices and quick bites, but if you're going in with high expectations for the pav bhaji, you might find it a bit underwhelming.

featured_reviews.name: Husain Cyclewala
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Special Pav bhaji was sooo good!!!
So was the paper dosa. Loved the food!
The service was quick, perfect for a quick snack or meal.
I just feel it would be very nice if they added some chairs for sitting or made a space overall, Standing and eating is not very comfortable in the heat.

featured_reviews.name: Hidayat Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text: Excellent spot for a quick bite! The Pav Bhaji and ice cream were both fantastic. Service is impressively fast, and having provision for car parking makes the visit very convenient. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Samarth Madhusudan Rao
featured_reviews.review_text:
Tried the Pav Bhaji, Tawa sandwich and the grape-vanilla milkshake.

The Pav Bhaji passes the muster, although I'm not a fan of the dish in general.

The veg/tawa sandwich was sumptuous and filling. Loaded with veggies.

The milkshake was superfilling and nice.

The staff is courteous and is on the lookout for what the customers want. Mr. Poojari and Vinay were sweet and their efficienct service makes me want me to go back again.

featured_reviews.name: MONITH BISWOJYOTHI
featured_reviews.review_text:
I ordered Paneer Frankie, Special Amar Falooda. Falooda was ok but Frankie was utterly disgusting. I mean there is aloo stuffing inside Paneer Frankie, who does that? Very less grated paneer has been provided. This place has no seating area, people are expected to stand and eat. The running items are Pav Bhaji, Grill Cheese Sandwich, Dosas and Mumbai Pizza. Nobody eats anything else-I guess that’s what they are known for.
For me the food service was slow, tool almost 15 mins to serve me Paneer Frankie and Falooda.

featured_reviews.name: Note & Navigate
featured_reviews.review_text:
Loved the vibe—the way people calmly sat on the ground, enjoying their food, added a very peaceful touch.
The place is located on the main road with limited ground mat seating. They also serve food in cars, so you can simply park your vehicle and enjoy your meal without stepping out.
It stays crowded most of the time, but the service is still quick and well-managed.
